messages.text: What evidence is required to compare our Oscilloscope solution with a competitor for Automotive without making unsupported claims?

## Short answer
To compare our Oscilloscope solution with a competitor for Automotive without unsupported claims, the passages require direct, citable evidence that ties together the specific R&S oscilloscope solution, the Automotive use case, and the named competitor; separate mentions of oscilloscopes, Automotive, or competitors are not enough because existing competitor battle-card material is sales positioning and not binding specifications [39][87].
## Evidence needed
- A formal R&S oscilloscope specification or features document for the exact oscilloscope model and option stack being compared, including document version, option codes, limits, test conditions, calibration conditions, and whether data is binding or only typical / nominal [59][80].  
- A formal competitor source, such as the competitor’s official datasheet, feature document, configuration guide, ordering data, or a credible third-party report, because existing R&S battle-card claims about competitors require competitor official data or third-party validation before use in customer or technical comparisons [4][87].  
- Direct evidence that the oscilloscope solution is used for the relevant Automotive application, because the Automotive passages support CMX500 / CMX-KA098 for NG eCall and AREG800A for automotive radar echo generation, but they do not state an R&S oscilloscope Automotive solution [79][80].  
- Direct evidence that the competitor product is used for the same Automotive application, with model, options, software version, release status, test setup, and conditions, because existing Keysight competitor descriptions lack official datasheets, option lists, versions, order numbers, release status, and test conditions [4][12].  
- Comparable measurement evidence under the same conditions, such as bandwidth, sample rate, probe model, calibration procedure, measurement uncertainty, test standard, DUT, software version, and pass/fail criteria, because sources repeatedly mark missing test conditions, configuration, option codes, and measurement details as unresolved limitations [35][56][87].  
- Evidence for any “better,” “only,” “first,” “lower TCO,” “fewer boxes,” or “leadership” statement must come from formal specs, conformance reports, third-party validation, or a documented TCO calculation, because these are identified as sales language and not verifiable technical specifications in the current battle-card sources [10][36][87].  
- If the comparison involves Automotive NG eCall, supported R&S evidence can cite only that R&S and Qualcomm Technologies used R&S CMX500 with CMX-KA098 to verify Snapdragon Auto 5G Modem-RF NG eCall functionality against EN 17240:2024 under a PSAP simulation context; the same source does not provide CMX500 configuration, CMX-KA098 version, license dependencies, setup, radio conditions, IMS configuration, voice codec, GNSS setup, or pass/fail details [79][35].  
- If the comparison involves automotive radar, supported R&S evidence can cite R&S AREG800A Automotive Radar Echo Generator specifications, Version 09.00, September 2025, including dynamic artificial object generation and maximum generated distance of 3000 m, but that is an automotive radar echo generator source, not an oscilloscope comparison source [80][65].  
## Current gap
The provided passages do not contain a supported Automotive competitor comparison for an R&S oscilloscope solution; they contain Automotive evidence for CMX500 / CMX-KA098 NG eCall and AREG800A radar echo generation, and separate oscilloscope evidence for O-RU or satellite-related roles, but no passage directly connects an R&S oscilloscope solution, Automotive, and a named competitor in one supported comparison [54][79][80][104].

- 來源說 [[eCall]] 於 2015 年導入，且自 2018 年起成為歐盟境內所有新車銷售的 mandatory requirement。
- 來源指出，隨著 2G / 3G circuit-switched cellular networks 逐漸 obsolete，emergency call systems 需要適配到 4G / 5G packet-switched cellular networks。
- 來源稱 [[European Commission]] 在其 most recent regulation 中定義 NG eCall 將自 **2026-01-01** 起成為 obligatory。
- 來源稱 EN 17240:2024 建立在 IP Multimedia Subsystem（[[IMS]]）networks 上測試 eCall systems 的 guidelines，涵蓋 advanced 4G LTE 與 5G NR technologies。
- [[Snapdragon Auto 5G Modem-RF]] 被描述為 5G automotive-grade platform，支援 high-speed connectivity、advanced positioning、Vehicle-to-Everything（[[V2X]]）、multi-band [[GNSS]] navigation 與 enhanced safety。
- 來源稱驗證流程使用 [[R&S CMX500]] mobile radio tester，作為 NG eCall voice and data transmission 的 comprehensive testing solution。
- 來源稱測試模擬 [[PSAP]]，並驗證 implementation at both ends with the [[EN 17240]]:2024 standard。
- 來源說 [[R&S CMX500]] 支援 4G 與 5G technologies，目標是讓方案 future-proof。
- [[Juergen Meyer]] 以 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] Vice President Market Segment Automotive 身分在新聞稿中引述，稱此次 collaboration 為 future emergency call services 建立 new benchmark。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] 搭配 [[R&S CMX-KA098]] software option 可在 realistic network conditions 下用於 NG eCall testing。
- 來源將合作定位為 mutually validating solutions、reducing effort、accelerating time to market for mutual customers。
- Press and media contact 為 [[Patrizia Muehlbauer]]，職稱 PR Manager Products & Standard Systems。
- 公司資訊段落稱 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 2024/2025 fiscal year net revenue 為 EUR 3.16 billion，2025-06-30 worldwide employees more than 15,000。

## Short answer
To compare our Oscilloscope solution with a competitor for Automotive without unsupported claims, the passages require direct, citable evidence that ties together the specific R&S oscilloscope solution, the Automotive use case, and the named competitor; separate mentions of oscilloscopes, Automotive, or competitors are not enough because existing competitor battle-card material is sales positioning and not binding specifications [39][87].
## Evidence needed
- A formal R&S oscilloscope specification or features document for the exact oscilloscope model and option stack being compared, including document version, option codes, limits, test conditions, calibration conditions, and whether data is binding or only typical / nominal [59][80].  
- A formal competitor source, such as the competitor’s official datasheet, feature document, configuration guide, ordering data, or a credible third-party report, because existing R&S battle-card claims about competitors require competitor official data or third-party validation before use in customer or technical comparisons [4][87].  
- Direct evidence that the oscilloscope solution is used for the relevant Automotive application, because the Automotive passages support CMX500 / CMX-KA098 for NG eCall and AREG800A for automotive radar echo generation, but they do not state an R&S oscilloscope Automotive solution [79][80].  
- Direct evidence that the competitor product is used for the same Automotive application, with model, options, software version, release status, test setup, and conditions, because existing Keysight competitor descriptions lack official datasheets, option lists, versions, order numbers, release status, and test conditions [4][12].  
- Comparable measurement evidence under the same conditions, such as bandwidth, sample rate, probe model, calibration procedure, measurement uncertainty, test standard, DUT, software version, and pass/fail criteria, because sources repeatedly mark missing test conditions, configuration, option codes, and measurement details as unresolved limitations [35][56][87].  
- Evidence for any “better,” “only,” “first,” “lower TCO,” “fewer boxes,” or “leadership” statement must come from formal specs, conformance reports, third-party validation, or a documented TCO calculation, because these are identified as sales language and not verifiable technical specifications in the current battle-card sources [10][36][87].  
- If the comparison involves Automotive NG eCall, supported R&S evidence can cite only that R&S and Qualcomm Technologies used R&S CMX500 with CMX-KA098 to verify Snapdragon Auto 5G Modem-RF NG eCall functionality against EN 17240:2024 under a PSAP simulation context; the same source does not provide CMX500 configuration, CMX-KA098 version, license dependencies, setup, radio conditions, IMS configuration, voice codec, GNSS setup, or pass/fail details [79][35].  
- If the comparison involves automotive radar, supported R&S evidence can cite R&S AREG800A Automotive Radar Echo Generator specifications, Version 09.00, September 2025, including dynamic artificial object generation and maximum generated distance of 3000 m, but that is an automotive radar echo generator source, not an oscilloscope comparison source [80][65].  
## Current gap
The provided passages do not contain a supported Automotive competitor comparison for an R&S oscilloscope solution; they contain Automotive evidence for CMX500 / CMX-KA098 NG eCall and AREG800A radar echo generation, and separate oscilloscope evidence for O-RU or satellite-related roles, but no passage directly connects an R&S oscilloscope solution, Automotive, and a named competitor in one supported comparison [54][79][80][104].
